name: Fat Kick
notes:
kickFatSeed: the plain base kick (variant 0) re-tuned to sit FULL under a
fixed peak: real saturation (0.55 → 1.2) glues the harmonic stack, a bigger,
faster drop (0.6 at 40/s) loads the 60-200 Hz punch band, and the body and
tail run longer. Loudest-300 ms RMS at equal peak −12.2 → −6.9 dB, crest 3.4.
It is a frozen literal (not a clone of drumKickSeed): `kick` itself was
retuned afterwards and Fat Kick must not move with it.
